commission_route.goal: Trace the power route at the Mission Table
commission_route.why: Sunlight makes more power than the battery can store
commission_route.result: Route traced: spare daylight power now has somewhere to go.
commission_route.hint: Follow the power from the arrays to the battery, then to the loads.

commission_result.goal: Check the result at the Mission Table
commission_result.why: See whether the spare power was used or overflowed
commission_result.result: Result checked: used power counts, overflow is lost.
commission_result.hint: Compare what was produced with what the battery kept.

charter_card.goal: Read the charter and emergency card
charter_card.why: It sets the limits that keep four cadets safe
charter_card.result: Charter read: the emergency limits are now yours to keep.
charter_card.hint: The card is on the wall near the Mission Table.

classify_information.goal: Sort the information at the response controls
classify_information.why: When Earth goes quiet, only local facts still work
classify_information.result: Sorted: local, stored and live-link information are now separate.
classify_information.hint: Ask of each item: does it survive without the Earth link?

roll_call.goal: Run the roll call at the board
roll_call.why: Four names on the board means nobody is missing
roll_call.result: Roll call complete: all four cadets accounted for.
roll_call.hint: Every token on the board is one person.

practice_fault.goal: Fix the practice fault at the controls
practice_fault.why: Practise solving it with local information only
practice_fault.result: Practice fault fixed without the Earth link.
practice_fault.hint: Use only what you sorted as local.

calibrate_probe.goal: Set the probe's dry zero at the bench
calibrate_probe.why: A probe only tells the truth after it is calibrated

span_probe.goal: Set the probe's wet span at the bench
span_probe.why: Two known references bracket every reading between them
span_probe.hint: The wet reference is the second point of the scale.

recheck_probe.goal: Recheck the dry zero and wet span
recheck_probe.why: A second check proves the probe holds its calibration
recheck_probe.result: Probe rechecked: it holds both references.
recheck_probe.hint: Repeat both references in the same order.

inspect_packet.why: Its label is older than the crew's names
inspect_packet.result: Packet inspected: seal, record and inscription noted without damage.
inspect_packet.hint: Look and record. Do not open it.

compare_atmosphere.why: An old cotton germination record is not this year's goal
compare_atmosphere.result: Diagrams compared: both chambers hold air; the goals differ.
compare_atmosphere.hint: Both chambers keep an atmosphere; only the purpose differs.

plant_alo.goal: Plant Alo's seed through the glove port
plant_alo.why: Alo grows in the sealed chamber outside the garden
plant_alo.result: Alo planted in the sealed external cassette.
plant_alo.hint: Work through the glove port; the chamber stays sealed.

plant_tara.goal: Plant Tara's seed in the reference bay
plant_tara.why: Tara is Alo's indoor partner, grown the same way
plant_tara.result: Tara planted in the indoor reference cassette.
plant_tara.hint: Same seed depth, same care, different place.

water_alo.goal: Set Alo's moisture to the calibrated band
water_alo.why: The probe you calibrated says when the soil is right
water_alo.result: Alo's moisture is in the band.
water_alo.hint: Watch the probe reading, not the water level.

water_tara.goal: Set Tara's moisture to the calibrated band
water_tara.why: Equal care for both plants keeps the comparison fair
water_tara.result: Tara's moisture is in the band.
water_tara.hint: Match the band exactly; equal care is the point.

label_alo.why: A label tells everyone which plant is which
label_alo.hint: The label names the plant's part in the test.

label_tara.why: Tara is the reference Alo's test is measured against
label_tara.hint: Reference means the plant you compare against.

seal_alo.why: A sealed cassette keeps air and water with the plant
seal_alo.hint: Check the seal line all the way round.

seal_tara.why: Tara gets the same seal as Alo

record_paired_conditions.goal: Record both plants' conditions and photographs
record_paired_conditions.why: Day-one records make every later change measurable
record_paired_conditions.result: Day-one conditions and photographs recorded for both plants.
record_paired_conditions.hint: Date, light, moisture, photo: for each plant.

confirm_services.why: Light, air and water must reach both chambers
confirm_services.result: Service connections confirmed for both chambers.
confirm_services.hint: Follow each line from the service room to the chamber.

test_hand_light.goal: Test and hang the hand light
test_hand_light.why: Alo needs light the crew can carry and trust
test_hand_light.hint: Test it before you trust it.

care_montage.goal: Log the care visits at the air console
care_montage.why: Each dated visit is one more fact about Alo
care_montage.result: Care visits logged, each with its date.
care_montage.hint: One observation per visit; the dates matter.

confirm_date_transition.goal: Confirm the date at the power panel
confirm_date_transition.why: Time moves to 25 April, the last day of light
confirm_date_transition.result: It is now 25 April 2046: two daylight shifts remain.
confirm_date_transition.hint: The calendar only moves when you confirm it.

arrange_timeline.goal: Arrange the Sun, link and station tracks
arrange_timeline.why: Sun, Earth link and station follow three separate clocks
arrange_timeline.result: Tracks arranged: sunset, link cutoff and station events are separate.
arrange_timeline.hint: Sunset does not end everything at once.

ack_schedule.why: Every role prepares before dark; the schedule shows when
ack_schedule.result: Schedule confirmed: everyone knows what to do before dark.
ack_schedule.hint: Check which role depends on another's work.

role_cards.goal: Read the crew notes at the power panel
role_cards.why: Kai and Amara set limits the night plan must respect
role_cards.result: Crew notes read: the power and air limits are known.
role_cards.hint: Two notes: Kai's power limit, Amara's air limit.

p02_shift1.goal: Plan the first shift at the power panel
p02_shift1.why: The Sun sets in two shifts; the battery must last
p02_shift1.hint: Store air while sunlight would overflow.

p02_stage_shift2.goal: Prepare shift 2 without locking it in
p02_stage_shift2.why: The shelter drill comes first; the forecast waits
p02_stage_shift2.result: Shift 2 prepared, not locked in. The drill comes next.
p02_stage_shift2.hint: Try it only; nothing changes yet.

shelter_drill.goal: Rehearse the shelter drill at the board
shelter_drill.why: A storm gives minutes; the drill makes shelter automatic
shelter_drill.result: Drill complete: entry and roll call rehearsed at no cost.
shelter_drill.hint: Entry, hatch, roll call, in that order.

verify_drill_baseline.goal: Check the baseline at the response controls
verify_drill_baseline.why: A drill must change nothing in the station
verify_drill_baseline.result: Baseline verified: the drill changed nothing.
verify_drill_baseline.hint: Compare the readings with the ones before the drill.

p02_shift2.goal: Lock in shift 2 at the response controls
p02_shift2.why: Sunset is at 18:00; this is the last daylight shift
p02_shift2.result: Shift 2 locked in at 18:00. The night begins.
p02_shift2.hint: Prepare shielding before the alarm, then return the water.

combine_cards.goal: Combine Mei's and Rafi's notes at the table
combine_cards.why: The garden and the storm outlook shape the night plan
combine_cards.result: Notes combined: plant thirst and storm risk share one reservoir.
combine_cards.hint: Which two facts change the water plan?

ack_earth_set.goal: Read the Earth-link cutoff at the Earth screen
ack_earth_set.why: After the cutoff the crew decides alone until dawn
ack_earth_set.result: Cutoff noted: until dawn the crew decides without Earth.
ack_earth_set.hint: The link ends in shift 4; the plan must not need it.

p02_shifts3_4.why: No sunlight now: every shift spends battery and air
p02_shifts3_4.hint: Open the worked Bloom plan or Guided plan.

confirm_four_sheltered.goal: Confirm four sheltered at the roll-call board
confirm_four_sheltered.why: A solar storm is replaying; nobody stays outside the shelter
confirm_four_sheltered.result: Four sheltered: everyone is behind the water wall.
confirm_four_sheltered.hint: Count the tokens on the board.

p02_shift5_alarm.goal: Answer the storm alarm at the response controls
p02_shift5_alarm.why: Wait, pump or stack: one choice protects the crew
p02_shift5_alarm.result: Alarm answered: all four stay sheltered while the storm passes.
p02_shift5_alarm.hint: The forecast says whether waiting is safe.

verify_exposure_order.goal: Check the radiation dose before draining water
verify_exposure_order.why: The water shields you; check the dose before removing it
verify_exposure_order.result: Dose checked before the drain: order kept.

return_water.goal: Return the borrowed water to the garden
return_water.why: The garden lent its water; Alo needs it back
return_water.hint: Return it only once the dose is checked.

p02_shifts6_7.goal: Plan the last dark shifts, 6 and 7
p02_shifts6_7.why: Dawn is two shifts away; the battery must reach it
p02_shifts6_7.result: Shifts 6 and 7 locked in. Dawn is next.
p02_shifts6_7.hint: Spend only what the battery can give until sunrise.

review_outcome.why: See what your plan did, or retry the checkpoint
review_outcome.result: Night reviewed. Dawn is next: go and see Alo.
review_outcome.hint: A retry restores the checkpoint before the night plan.

verify_chamber.goal: Check Alo's chamber at the glove port
verify_chamber.why: Pressure and conditions must be safe before you look
verify_chamber.result: Chamber safe: pressure and conditions verified.
verify_chamber.hint: Pressure first; the shutter stays closed until then.

open_shutter.why: Alo bloomed in the night; see it safely
open_shutter.hint: The shutter only opens on a verified chamber.

tag_bloom.why: The tag unlocks a recording left for this moment
tag_bloom.result: Image tagged: a stored recording plays.

inspect_tara.goal: Inspect Tara in the reference bay
inspect_tara.why: Alo needs a partner plant; Tara is the candidate
inspect_tara.result: Tara inspected: her bud has been cared for all night too.
inspect_tara.hint: Compare how far Tara has grown against Alo.

complete_debrief.why: Your decisions and evidence become Chapter 1's record
complete_debrief.result: Debrief complete. Chapter 1 is in the record.
complete_debrief.hint: Decisions first, then the evidence that supports them.

inspect_alo_identity.goal: Read Alo's identity at the garden bay
inspect_alo_identity.why: Compatible flowers are needed to make seeds
inspect_alo_identity.prompt: Read Alo's identity at the garden bay
inspect_alo_identity.result: Alo's identity checked against the compatible cultivar record.
inspect_alo_identity.hint: Compare the plant label with the protocol, not just its flower.

inspect_tara_identity.goal: Read Tara's identity at the reference bay
inspect_tara_identity.why: Tara must have her own verified partner record
inspect_tara_identity.prompt: Read Tara's identity at the reference bay
inspect_tara_identity.result: Tara's identity checked; both partners have separate records.
inspect_tara_identity.hint: Find Tara's label beside the indoor reference plant.

ack_live_link.goal: Check Earth contact at the garden console
ack_live_link.why: A live reply needs an available Earth path
ack_live_link.prompt: Check Earth contact at the garden console
ack_live_link.result: Earth contact checked; this conversation is live.
ack_live_link.hint: Read the contact indicator before treating a message as live.

open_pollination_protocol.goal: Read the transfer protocol at the garden
open_pollination_protocol.why: Pollen must travel while both chambers keep their air
open_pollination_protocol.prompt: Read the transfer protocol at the garden
open_pollination_protocol.result: Protocol opened: the chambers stay sealed, so you must be the bee.
open_pollination_protocol.hint: Look for donor, recipient and containment checks.

identify_anther.goal: Find the anthers on the bench diagram
identify_anther.why: The donor's pollen comes from a specific flower structure
identify_anther.prompt: Find the anthers on the bench diagram
identify_anther.result: Pollen-bearing anthers identified on the practice diagram.
identify_anther.hint: Use the diagram's structure labels as well as its colours.

identify_stigma.goal: Find the stigma on the bench diagram
identify_stigma.why: Pollen needs contact with the recipient's receptive structure
identify_stigma.prompt: Find the stigma on the bench diagram
identify_stigma.result: Receptive stigma identified on the practice diagram.
identify_stigma.hint: Compare the receiving surface with the pollen-bearing structures.

assign_brush_directions.goal: Label both clean brushes at the bench
assign_brush_directions.why: Separate brushes keep the two transfer records clear
assign_brush_directions.prompt: Label both clean brushes at the bench
assign_brush_directions.result: Clean brushes assigned to separate transfer directions.
assign_brush_directions.hint: Read the donor and recipient labels before labelling a brush.

practice_transfer_model.goal: Rehearse the transfer at the practice bench
practice_transfer_model.why: Practice protects the real flowers and their records
practice_transfer_model.prompt: Rehearse the transfer at the practice bench
practice_transfer_model.result: Practice done on the model flower. Next, the real route.
practice_transfer_model.hint: Follow the labelled structures on the model before using a living flower.

check_space_weather.goal: Check space weather at the transfer station
check_space_weather.why: Check the Sun is quiet before carrying pollen through the airlock
check_space_weather.prompt: Check space weather at the transfer station
check_space_weather.result: Space-weather status checked for the planned transfer.
check_space_weather.hint: Read the dated status before preparing the carrier.

prepare_closed_carrier.goal: Prepare the carrier at the transfer station
prepare_closed_carrier.why: A closed carrier protects pollen and containment
prepare_closed_carrier.prompt: Prepare the carrier at the transfer station
prepare_closed_carrier.result: The closed carrier is ready for the transfer.
prepare_closed_carrier.hint: Check its latch and labels before moving it.

verify_transfer_boundaries.goal: Trace pressure boundaries at the transfer station
verify_transfer_boundaries.why: Opening both boundaries together would lose containment
verify_transfer_boundaries.prompt: Trace pressure boundaries at the transfer station
verify_transfer_boundaries.result: Pressure-boundary order checked; both chambers retain their air.
verify_transfer_boundaries.hint: Follow the interlock diagram through the outward and return legs.

preview_cycle_budget.goal: Try the whole pollen trip at the diagram
preview_cycle_budget.why: One route charge covers both transfer directions
preview_cycle_budget.prompt: Try the whole pollen trip at the diagram
preview_cycle_budget.result: Trip tried: one round trip costs one route charge. Nothing spent yet.
preview_cycle_budget.hint: Include both directions when reading the cycle cost.

p03_scan_tara.goal: Scan Tara at the transfer microscope
p03_scan_tara.why: The donor must match the pollen record
p03_scan_tara.prompt: Scan Tara at the transfer microscope
p03_scan_tara.hint: Read the plant label before collecting any pollen.

p03_collect_tara.goal: Collect Tara's pollen at the transfer bench
p03_collect_tara.why: The receiving flower needs its partner's pollen
p03_collect_tara.prompt: Collect Tara's pollen at the transfer bench
p03_collect_tara.result: Tara's pollen collected with the labelled clean brush.
p03_collect_tara.hint: Use the pollen-bearing structure identified during practice.

p03_seal_a.goal: Seal Tara's carrier at the transfer bench
p03_seal_a.why: Pollen must remain contained along the route
p03_seal_a.prompt: Seal Tara's carrier at the transfer bench
p03_seal_a.hint: Check the closure indicator before the carrier moves.

p03_transfer_alo.goal: Transfer pollen to Alo at the glove ports
p03_transfer_alo.why: Useful contact must reach the recipient's receptive structure
p03_transfer_alo.prompt: Transfer pollen to Alo at the glove ports
p03_transfer_alo.result: Tara's pollen is on Alo's flower. Seeds, if any, take weeks.
p03_transfer_alo.hint: Compare recipient and donor labels, then use the diagram's receiving surface.

p03_scan_alo.goal: Scan Alo at the transfer microscope
p03_scan_alo.why: The return transfer needs its own donor check
p03_scan_alo.prompt: Scan Alo at the transfer microscope
p03_scan_alo.result: Alo's donor identity scanned for the return transfer.
p03_scan_alo.hint: Read Alo's label again rather than reusing Tara's donor record.

p03_collect_alo.goal: Collect Alo's pollen at the transfer bench
p03_collect_alo.why: The reciprocal direction needs a separate clean brush
p03_collect_alo.prompt: Collect Alo's pollen at the transfer bench
p03_collect_alo.result: Alo's pollen collected with the separately labelled clean brush.
p03_collect_alo.hint: Check that this brush belongs to the return direction.

p03_seal_b.goal: Seal Alo's carrier at the transfer bench
p03_seal_b.why: The return leg needs the same containment checks
p03_seal_b.prompt: Seal Alo's carrier at the transfer bench
p03_seal_b.hint: Read the closure indicator before starting the return leg.

p03_transfer_tara.goal: Transfer pollen to Tara at the glove ports
p03_transfer_tara.why: Both plants need a recorded partner transfer
p03_transfer_tara.prompt: Transfer pollen to Tara at the glove ports
p03_transfer_tara.result: Alo's pollen is on Tara's flower. Both plants now have a partner.
p03_transfer_tara.hint: Check the recipient label before making the modelled contact.

record_stem_prediction.goal: Save a prediction at the garden bench
record_stem_prediction.why: Stem colour shows some genes, not all; save a guess to test
record_stem_prediction.prompt: Save a prediction at the garden bench
record_stem_prediction.result: Prediction saved. Months from now you will compare it with what grows.
record_stem_prediction.hint: Separate the colour you can observe from the ratio you cannot yet know.

order_lifecycle.goal: Order growth observations at the Mission Table
order_lifecycle.why: Pollination does not make seeds ready tomorrow
order_lifecycle.prompt: Order growth observations at the Mission Table
order_lifecycle.result: Flower-to-harvest observations placed in life-cycle order.
order_lifecycle.hint: Match each picture to its observed development before arranging the dates.

separate_current_evidence.goal: Sort plant evidence at the Mission Table
separate_current_evidence.why: Reference pictures must not become current observations
separate_current_evidence.prompt: Sort plant evidence at the Mission Table
separate_current_evidence.result: Current flowers, old seedlings and reference images kept distinct.
separate_current_evidence.hint: Check each image's source and date before using it as evidence.

inspect_recorder_identifier.goal: Read the recorder label at the table
inspect_recorder_identifier.why: An equipment match can connect two records
inspect_recorder_identifier.prompt: Read the recorder label at the table
inspect_recorder_identifier.result: The recorder's number matches the old trial card. Take it to the service bench.
inspect_recorder_identifier.hint: Compare the full equipment label, not a person's initials.

collect_serial_card.goal: Photograph the serial at the service bench
collect_serial_card.why: Peeling the newer label would destroy the only original
collect_serial_card.prompt: Photograph the serial at the service bench
collect_serial_card.result: Serial plate photographed without peeling the original label.
collect_serial_card.hint: Use the camera to preserve both the number and its source.

collect_date_card.goal: Photograph the date at the service bench
collect_date_card.why: Historical context needs a sourced date
collect_date_card.prompt: Photograph the date at the service bench
collect_date_card.result: Maintenance date photographed with its source label.
collect_date_card.hint: Keep the date attached to the object it describes.

collect_trial_stage_card.goal: Photograph the growth chart at the bench
collect_trial_stage_card.why: Seedlings are different evidence from flowers
collect_trial_stage_card.prompt: Photograph the growth chart at the bench
collect_trial_stage_card.result: Trial chart photographed; the old plants had not flowered.
collect_trial_stage_card.hint: Read the documented development rather than guessing from curled leaves.

exclude_identity_claim.goal: Check identity claims at the service bench
exclude_identity_claim.why: An equipment label cannot prove a person's name
exclude_identity_claim.prompt: Check identity claims at the service bench
exclude_identity_claim.result: No proof yet of who N. is, so the name stays a question.
exclude_identity_claim.hint: Ask which source actually names a person.

assign_date_token.goal: Match the date on the reconstruction board
assign_date_token.why: A supported date gives the recording its context
assign_date_token.prompt: Match the date on the reconstruction board
assign_date_token.result: Date field matched to the photographed source.
assign_date_token.hint: Compare the empty field with the maintenance-date photograph.

assign_device_token.goal: Match the device on the reconstruction board
assign_device_token.why: The fragment must belong to the checked recorder
assign_device_token.prompt: Match the device on the reconstruction board
